sentence: My uncle, who is very ______, always lends me his car. (help)
explanation: We need an adjective that describes the uncle, and the suffix -ful creates adjectives meaning full of a quality. Helpless is also an adjective, but it means unable to help yourself, so it does not fit the kind meaning of the sentence. Spanish speakers may pick help or helpfully because both look close to the Spanish root, but only the adjective fits between 'very' and the noun phrase.
